note: lp is np.log(rows-with-1e-8-floor, renormalized per frame), identical to test_evidence.py's `self.lp` helper. Every case is cross-checked at generation time against a brute-force / independent computation (see dump_golden.py) - these are not just captured outputs.

cases.name: forward_matches_exhaustive_paths_and_repeats
cases.description: CTC forward-algorithm log-likelihood for several targets over the same 3-frame lattice; cross-checked against brute-force enumeration of every frame path.

cases.name: impossible_repeat_rejected
cases.description: Two frames cannot host [4,4] (repeated label needs an intervening blank frame): score is -inf and trace is null.

cases.name: realization_likelihood_sums_disjoint_sequences_once
cases.description: realization_likelihood([[4],[5],[4]]) must equal the probability of collapsed output in {[4],[5]}, not double-counting the repeated [4] sequence.

cases.name: trace_recovers_emission_span_for_a_present_target
cases.description: Even though the dominant label is 5 (not the target 4), the target 4 has enough mass in frames 1-2 for a finite-probability alignment with a recoverable span.
